text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203547

g.text: COMPLETE AGENT ARCHITECTURE

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203547

g.text: CURRENT OBSERVATION

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203547

g.text: Public prices, market stock, open shops and visible rival farm; own cash, inventory and worker state

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #009e73

g.text: COMPATIBLE PRODUCTION CHOICES
Start from a replay-derived work schedule
Synchronize selected wheat-to-carrot cycles
Choose sheep or cows before buying new animals
Update purchases, yields, bags and delivery times

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0072b2

g.text: FORECAST-GUIDED SELLER
16 observed features estimate rival sales
Four forecast intervals cover the next 24 turns
Compare sale quantities and settlement scenarios
Apply cash, stock-age and endgame rules

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #009e73

g.text: FARM EXECUTION AND LOCAL REPAIR
Follow the selected worker schedule
Clear weeds and reschedule disrupted tasks
Compute required purchases and hiring times
Reserve inputs, working capital and order slots

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c88a08

g.text: ORDER SCHEDULER
Protect necessary farm orders within the 10-slot cap
Accept sales only within the available capacity
Place admitted sales early when funding is needed
Replan using observed inventory and actual fills

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203547

g.text: OFFICIAL GAME ENGINE
Execute worker actions, then settle shared-market orders
Return the resulting farm state, inventory, prices and cash
